# Beetles: choice of link function
# Generated from JuliaBUGS.BUGSExamples.VOLUME_2.beetles
using JuliaBUGS

model_def = JuliaBUGS.@bugs("""
model {
    for( i in 1 : N ) {
        r[i] ~ dbin(p[i],n[i])
        logit(p[i]) <- alpha.star + beta * (x[i] - mean(x[]))
        # probit(p[i]) <- alpha.star + beta * (x[i] - mean(x[]))
        # cexpexp(p[i]) <- alpha.star + beta * (x[i] - mean(x[]))
        rhat[i] <- n[i] * p[i]
    }
    alpha <- alpha.star - beta * mean(x[])
    beta ~ dnorm(0.0,0.001)
    alpha.star ~ dnorm(0.0,0.001)
}
""", false)

build_model(data) = JuliaBUGS.compile(model_def, data)
